patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Zenzap and Zoom share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Zenzap only if your buying job matches “Professional work-chat app for frontline and multi-site teams replacing WhatsApp groups — ” rather than Zoom's shape. Choose Zoom only if your buying job matches “Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited research floo” rather than Zenzap's shape. Workflow advantage: Zenzap leans shared coverage; Zoom leans business-phone. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Zenzap and Zoom share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Zenzap is Professional work-chat app for frontline and multi-site teams replacing WhatsApp groups — free tier, Pro $3/user/month yearly, Business+ $8 ; Zoom is Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited research floor ~$15–16/user/month; free meetings/chat exist but.
- Workflow coverage skew: Zenzap-leaning — vs Zoom-leaning business-phone.
- Researched limits: Zenzap — Integrations with other business tools and API access require Business+; Zoom — Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service.

Limitations — Zenzap: Integrations with other business tools and API access require Business+; Voice and video calls require Pro; call recording and transcription require Business+; Zoom: Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service; Phone seat floors and Pro Plus / Business Plus bundles are medium confidence and region-sensitive.

Poor-fit cases: Zenzap is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Integrations with other business tools and API access require Business+ · Zoom is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service · Avoid Zenzap if you actually need Zoom's motion (Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited res)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
